Messages.Author: Errol T
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ I an official ruling so I have something for my game this week I
need you to give the ruling on decapitate, I feel in its wording that the
superior version can be used at range and it makes know difference where
the dmg is coming from as long as the opposing vamp is going to topor and
the playing vamp is not.

Errol T

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


The superior can be used at close or long range.
It doesn't matter how the opposing vampire ends up going to torpor.
